_comment: Shape of a publish package's metadata block. scripts/pipeline.py --package produces this; compliance_gate.check_publish_package() validates it. Fields marked REQUIRED-TRUE / REQUIRED-FALSE are non-negotiables and are checked in software.
_title_rules: <=100 chars, <=60 to avoid feed truncation. Honest description of the video. No clickbait, no curiosity gap, no ALL CAPS, no CTA, no third-party brand.
_description_rules: No links. No email addresses. No contact routes. No call to action. Credit the public-domain source of the rhyme - good practice, and useful evidence if a Content ID claim lands.
_thumbnail_rules: <=4 words. Legible at phone size. Honest about content. No third-party characters or trade dress.
_nn1: REQUIRED-TRUE. NN-1. Every video, no exceptions. Verify on the review screen after setting it.
_nn2_comments: REQUIRED-TRUE. Automatic under MFK - declared here so the upload checklist can be verified against the package.
_nn2_ads: REQUIRED-FALSE. Contextual advertising only. Model channel revenue on that, not a general-audience CPM.
_nn7: REQUIRED-TRUE when visual_style is photorealistic; false for stylised/cartoon. The kids setting is unconditional; only this label is conditional. If genuinely unclear, disclose.
_tag_rules: Descriptive, not stuffed. Never a third-party brand or channel name.
_unavailable_on_mfk: Both are unavailable on Made-for-Kids content. Declared false so nothing downstream expects them.
